deploy.startCommand: sh -c "test -n \"$SUPABASE_DB_URL\" || { echo 'SUPABASE_DB_URL is required for API realtime' >&2; exit 1; }; if [ -n \"$GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON\" ]; then printf '%s' \"$GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON\" > /app/credentials/vertex-ai-service-account.json && export GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/app/credentials/vertex-ai-service-account.json; fi; exec node dist/server.js"
